additionalRules: If your Army includes Elrond, then Rivendell Knights do not count towards this Army's Bow Limit.

specialRules.name: Protection of Imladris
specialRules.text: Friendly models gain a bonus of +1 to any Courage Tests they are required to take.

specialRules.name: Defensive Stance
specialRules.text: Friendly Elf Warrior models may re-roll To Wound rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes so long as they have not Moved during the preceding Move Phase.

specialRules.name: Invoke the Bruinen
specialRules.text: Once per game, so long as either Elrond or Arwen are alive and on the battlefield, you may use this special rule at the start of any Move Phase in which your Army is Broken. Place a 25mm Marker anywhere within 12" and Line of Sight of Elrond or Arwen, and then roll a D6 for each enemy model within 3" of that Marker. If the roll is equal to or over the Strength of the model, or is a natural 6, then the model immediately suffers a Strength 4 hit and, if it survives, will be knocked Prone.

specialRules.name: Hadhafang
specialRules.text: This is a Unique Elven hand-and-a-half weapon. A model wielding Hadhafang gains a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes against a Spirit model.

specialRules.name: Vilya
specialRules.text: This is a Unique piece of Wargear. Elrond may re-roll any failed Fate rolls.

specialRules.name: Lord of the West
specialRules.text: This model may re-roll a single D6 when making a Duel Roll. Additionally, they may re-roll a single D6 when rolling To Wound when making Strikes.

specialRules.name: Foresight of the Eldar
specialRules.text: At the start of the game, roll a D6 for Foresight Points. During the roll for Priority, so long as he is alive, Elrond can spend Foresight Points to increase the roll on his controlling player's roll for Priority, to a maximum of 6.

specialRules.name: Unbreakable Bond
specialRules.text: If Elrohir is slain, for the remainder of the game Elladan increases his Strength by 1 and must always Charge an enemy model when able, prioritising the model that killed Elrohir.

specialRules.name: Twin Elven Blades
specialRules.text: Whilst he has the Infantry Keyword, Elladan can choose to fight with 3 Attacks rather than 2, use his Elven weapons as hand-and-a-half weapons, or use them to parry (counts as Shielding).

specialRules.name: Strength of Brotherhood
specialRules.text: Whilst within 3" of Elrohir, Elladan gains the Dominant (2) special rule and may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes.

specialRules.name: Noldorin Daggers
specialRules.text: These are Elven hand weapons, which Erestor may also use as Elven throwing weapons. Erestor may re-roll To Wound rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes or shooting attacks with these weapons.

specialRules.name: Song of Elbereth
specialRules.text: Friendly Rivendell models within 3" of Lindir gain the Resistant to Magic special rule.

specialRules.name: Wise Counsel
specialRules.text: If Elrond is within 6" of Lindir at the start of a turn, then Elrond gains a free Will Point for the turn.

specialRules.name: Powers of Nature
specialRules.text: If this model rolls a natural 6 during its Casting Test, then upon completion of the Magical Power it regains a number of Will Points equal to the number of Will Points spent during the Casting Test.

specialRules.name: Independent Hero
specialRules.text: Independent Heroes may not lead troops and may not be the army's leader. They may, however, be included in another Hero model's warband as one of their followers.

specialRules.name: Mithril Coat
specialRules.text: This is a Unique piece of Mithril armour. The wearer may re-roll Fate rolls of a 1.

specialRules.name: Sting
specialRules.text: This is a Unique Elven hand weapon. A model gains a bonus of +1 to their Strength when making Strikes with Sting.

specialRules.name: Slip Away
specialRules.text: Whilst Bilbo is wearing the One Ring and is Invisible, enemy models Engaged in Combat with Bilbo will halve their Fight Value even if there are other models friendly to Bilbo Engaged in the same Combat.
